metas.name: American Doctor
metas.description: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza in the middle of a genocide comitted by Israel, and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

metas.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
metas.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

metas.name: Mickey: The Story of a Mouse
metas.description: Mickey Mouse is one of the most enduring symbols in our history. Those three simple circles take on meaning for virtually everyone on the planet. So ubiquitous in our lives that he can seem invisible, Mickey is something we all share, with unique memories and feelings. Over the course of his nearly century-long history, Mickey functions like a mirror, reflecting our personal and cultural values back at us. "Mickey: The Story of a Mouse" explores Mickey's significance, getting to the core of what Mickey's cultural impact says about each of us and about our world.

metas.name: Pretty Things
metas.description: A look into the world of 20th century burlesque queens. The film premiered on HBO and the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation in 2006

metas.name: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Long-lost footage from Elvis Presley's legendary Las Vegas residency in the 1970s woven together with rare 16mm footage from Elvis on Tour, and 8mm from the Graceland archive, plus recordings of Elvis telling "his side of the story" rediscovered during Baz Luhrmann's research for his 2022 film, Elvis.

metas.name: Reimagining Rodan
metas.description: A look at the newest version of one of Godzilla's greatest rivals.

metas.name: Piano Blues
metas.description: Director — and piano player — Clint Eastwood explores his life-long passion for piano blues, using a treasure trove of rare historical footage in addition to interviews and performances by such living legends as Pinetop Perkins and Jay McShann, as well as Dave Brubeck and Marcia Ball.

metas.name: DDP: Relentless
metas.description: Sometimes the worst thing that happens to you can become one of the greatest. From being dyslexic to starting a wrestling career at 35, to risking it all for a new dream of saving lives.

metas.name: Henry Moore
metas.description: A documentary on the work of artist Henry Moore.

metas.name: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
metas.description: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

metas.name: The Corporation
metas.description: Since the late 18th century American legal decision that the business corporation organizational model is legally a person, it has become a dominant economic, political and social force around the globe. This film takes an in-depth psychological examination of the organization model through various case studies. What the study illustrates is that in the its behaviour, this type of "person" typically acts like a dangerously destructive psychopath without conscience. Furthermore, we see the profound threat this psychopath has for our world and our future, but also how the people with courage, intelligence and determination can do to stop it.

metas.name: Silver Reunion
metas.description: During the summer of 2012, a secret meeting took place. But this was no ordinary gathering; instead, a monumental choice was to be made. Reuniting over four decades after the USA men's Olympic basketball team controversially lost the gold to the Russians and declined the silver medal, the 12 team members reunited in Lexington, Ky. to make a decision. And like the jury in "12 Angry Men," the verdict needed to be unanimous -- accept, or forever refuse the medals for a game many of them believe they never lost.

metas.name: Being James Bond
metas.description: Daniel Craig candidly reflects on his 15 year adventure as James Bond. Including never-before-seen archival footage from Casino Royale to the upcoming 25th film No Time To Die, Craig shares his personal memories in conversation with 007 producers, Michael G Wilson and Barbara Broccoli.

metas.name: American Arctic
metas.description: Vast, wild, and remote, the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge is where some of the world’s greatest wildlife spectacles unfold. Situated in northeastern Alaska, this Refuge has long protected survivors of the Ice Age that still roam a frozen wilderness. Now, this icy fortress is melting due to climate change. For the caribou, musk oxen, polar bears, and Arctic foxes, the Ice Age is slipping away.

metas.name: Dưới Lòng Đại Dương - Fathom
metas.description: Hai nhà sinh vật học tìm cách giải mã sự giao tiếp phức tạp của loài cá voi khổng lồ. Tiến sĩ Michelle Fournet và Tiến sĩ Ellen Garland nghiên cứu đại dương ở hai bán cầu đối lập với sứ mệnh khám phá một nền văn hóa lâu đời hơn cả nền văn minh nhân loại.

metas.name: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
metas.description: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

metas.name: Everybody’s Everything
metas.description: The story of artist Lil Peep from his birth in Long Island and meteoric rise as a genre blending pop star & style icon, to his death due to an accidental opioid overdose in Arizona at just 21 years of age.

metas.name: Absent
metas.description: Documentary on the social pandemic of fatherlessness afflicting today's societies.

metas.name: Thương Mến, Antosha
metas.description: From a prolific career in film and television, Anton Yelchin left an indelible legacy as an actor. Through his journals and other writings, his photography, the original music he wrote, and interviews with his family, friends, and colleagues, this film looks not just at Anton's impressive career, but at a broader portrait of the man.

metas.name: On Location
metas.description: The short piece features remarks and footage from Forster, Wilson, Bradley, Evans, Kurylenko and Arterton.

metas.name: Silhouette City
metas.description: This beautifully crafted and thoughtful film deploys rarely seen archival footage, right-wing movement propaganda and original investigative material to probe the origins of apocalyptic Christian nationalism and its most extreme adherents, as they move from the margins to the mainstream. A riveting historical document as well as cautionary commentary on power vacuums, racism and civil society apathy, SILHOUETTE CITY prefigures the so-called “alt right” forces that now rally around Trump as their emboldening metropole.  This history is troubling enough to be fiction, but in fact, this is the factual story of one faction of American fascism and its rise to the mainstream.

metas.name: Cô Giáo Bạch Tuộc
metas.description: Có tình bạn khác thường với nàng bạch tuộc sống ở rừng tảo bẹ Nam Phi, một nhà làm phim tìm hiểu thêm nhiều điều khi sinh vật ấy chia sẻ những bí ẩn về thế giới của mình.

metas.name: Gấu Bắc Cực
metas.description: A new mother’s memories of her own youth prepare her to navigate motherhood in the increasingly challenging world that polar bears face today.

metas.name: Come Saturday
metas.description: Part of BFI collection "Portrait of a People."

metas.name: 11/9: Trong Phòng Tình Huống Của Tổng Thống - 9/11: Inside the President's War Room
metas.description: Khám phá loạt sự kiện xảy ra vào ngày 11 tháng 9 năm 2001 qua góc nhìn của Tổng Thống Bush và các cố vấn thân cận. Qua bộ phim tài liệu này, họ chia sẻ chi tiết về những thời khắc then chốt và các quyết định quan trọng trong ngày lịch sử ấy.

metas.name: Ngôi sao miền Tây
metas.description: Những màn trình diễn âm nhạc hòa nhịp với phim tư liệu và câu chuyện chân thực trong bộ phim tài liệu về album cùng tên được đánh giá cao của Bruce Springsteen.

metas.name: George Michael: The Faith Tour
metas.description: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

metas.name: LX Forty
metas.description: Filmmaker Marc Forster expresses his thoughts and reflections on life.

metas.name: Clarkson: Thriller
metas.description: Welcome to my all new DVD Thriller, which, as the name suggests, is all about thrills at the wheel. Aston Martin’s gentleman thug, the DBS, takes on its rivals from Italy. The lightweight Lamborghini Superleggera battles it out on the track with Ferrari’s 430 Scuderia and my test of the best takes me to the breathtaking roads of the Swiss Alps, the no limits German autobahn – and, er, Norfolk.

metas.name: Những Nữ Thợ Lặn Cuối Cùng - The Last of the Sea Women
metas.description: Trên bờ biển của đảo Jeju, một nhóm thợ lặn Hàn Quốc quyết liệt đấu tranh để cứu truyền thống đang mai một của họ trước những mối đe dọa cận kề.

metas.name: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
metas.description: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.

metas.name: Trái Đất: Một Ngày Tuyệt Vời
metas.description: Trái Đất: Một Ngày Tuyệt Vời : một hành trình đáng kinh ngạc tiết lộ sức mạnh tuyệt vời của thế giới tự nhiên. Trong suốt một ngày, chúng tôi theo dõi mặt trời từ những ngọn núi cao nhất đến những hòn đảo xa xôi nhất đến những khu rừng kỳ lạ. Đột phá trong công nghệ làm phim mang bạn đến gần với một loạt các nhân vật khó quên. Nói với sự hài hước, gần gũi và cảm giác lộng lẫy về vẻ huy hoàng điện ảnh, Trái đất: Một ngày tuyệt vời làm nổi bật mỗi ngày đầy những điều kỳ diệu hơn bạn có thể tưởng tượng cho đến bây giờ.

metas.name: Lily
metas.description: TV special starring Lily Tomlin

metas.name: The Bridge
metas.description: The Bridge is a controversial documentary that shows people jumping to their death from the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco - the world's most popular suicide destination. Interviews with the victims' loved ones describe their lives and mental health.

metas.name: Hard Knocks
metas.description: Hard Knocks dives deep into this bizarre fusion of sport and theatre in order to uncover the true art of professional wrestling; blending combat and athleticism with drama and showmanship to captivate the minds of the audience, suspending any disbelief that what they are seeing is not real. Although you can hardly epitomize it as simply "real" or "fake", there is no denying the tremendous skill and aptitude required of each performer. Yet despite this and the often harsh realities of each match, to most people, professional wrestling is a laughing stock. Director Arthur Cauty interviews wrestlers, referees and promoters alike, with world famous stars of the WWE aligning with the stars of tomorrow to voice their opinions, revealing startling truths about this illusive business. This film will shock and astound, leaving you with a new found respect for professional wrestling and the men and women who dedicate their lives and bodies to this obscure art form.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

metas.name: Song đề xã hội
metas.description: Phim tài liệu – chính kịch này khám phá tác động nguy hiểm của mạng xã hội đến con người, có các chuyên gia công nghệ cảnh tỉnh về nội dung sáng tạo của chính họ.

metas.name: Assignment Children
metas.description: Filmed on a world wide trip by Danny Kaye, this is an examination of the state of children in the third world.

metas.name: Untouchable
metas.description: The inside story of the rise and fall of Harvey Weinstein reveals how, over decades, he acquired and protected his power even when scandal threatened to engulf him. Former colleagues and accusers detail the method and consequences of his alleged abuse, hoping for justice and also to inspire change.

metas.name: Finding Fela
metas.description: Fela Anikulapo Kuti created the musical movement Afrobeat and used it as a political forum to oppose the Nigerian dictatorship and advocate for the rights of oppressed people. This is the story of his life, music, and political importance.

metas.name: Bushman
metas.description: 1968: Martin Luther King, Robert Kennedy, and Bobby Hutton are among the recent dead. In Nigeria, the Civil War is entering its second year with no end in sight. In San Francisco, the adventures of Gabriel, a young Nigerian reflects tribal, personal, and racial frictions during the tumultuous sixties. Truth is stranger than fiction in Bushman, a rare sort of film portrait, part document, part imagined – poetic in its approach to real events.

metas.name: Assassins
metas.description: True crime meets global spy thriller in this gripping account of the assassination of Kim Jong-nam, the half brother of the North Korean leader. The film follows the trial of the two female assassins, probing the question: were the women trained killers or innocent pawns of North Korea?

metas.name: Nightcrawler Reborn
metas.description: This short documentary looks at X2's main new hero. Writer/artist Chuck Austen discusses his entrance into comics and his take on the character as well as some of Nightcrawler's history.

metas.name: The Masterplan
metas.description: Visually narrated by Jason Flemyng, The Masterplan explores the revival of Battersea Power Station from derelict landmark to vibrant cultural hub.

metas.name: Southern Comfort
metas.description: This moving documentary chronicles the last year in the life of Robert Eads, a trans man dying of ovarian cancer. We're introduced to several prominent figures in Robert's life -- most importantly, his life partner and caretaker Lola Cola, who is also trans. The two prepare to lead a panel at the annual Southern Comfort conference, a yearly event created for transgender individuals.

metas.name: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
metas.description: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

metas.name: Buke & Gase
metas.description: In 2020, at the height of the Covid-19 pandemic, when tours were canceled and all live music went silent, one band refused to stay quiet. The musical duo Buke and Gase performs to the eerily empty, famed hall Basilica Hudson.

metas.name: Soul Patrol
metas.description: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

metas.name: Starbucks Unfiltered
metas.description: How the American coffee chain, now global, has conquered the urban middle class. This investigation on three continents reveals the carefully hidden face of the brand.

metas.name: Glastopia
metas.description: In this personal film, Julien Temple, who directed the definitive documentary history of the Glastonbury Festival, explores the alternative side of the festival away from the spotlight of the main stages with their global pop superstars.  In fields known as Shangri La, Arcadia, the Unfair Ground, Strummerville, Block 9 and the Common, every year an unlikely attempt at utopia takes shape. Here, the festival reconnects with its radical, countercultural origins combining underground music, performance art and some of the funniest and most provocative sights of the festival with a dark, urgent 21st century spontaneity.  Filmed at the 2011 festival, this 75 minute documentary features Michael Eavis, the creators of, and visitors to the true heart of the Glastonbury, and, fuelled by the music of tomorrow, explores the hopes, dreams and personal utopias of those who, for one weekend in June, come together as the tribes of 21st Century Albion.

metas.name: 4 Presidents
metas.description: What is the common thread among the only four U.S. Presidents who have been assassinated - Lincoln, Garfield, McKinley, and Kennedy? They were also the only four presidents to ever to take away money-issuing control from the private banks and turn it over to the U.S. Treasury.  Within less than a year of each president doing so, they were murdered. And within months of their vice president successors assuming their offices, they returned the money issuing power back to the private banks.  4 PRESIDENTS provides the first-ever in depth analysis of this very likely - and very frightening - historic conspiracy.

metas.name: Noah Kahan: Trải nghiệm thoát xác
metas.description: Sau khi vụt sáng thành danh toàn cầu, ca sĩ kiêm nhạc sĩ Noah Kahan trở về quê nhà Vermont để tìm lại chính mình trong bộ phim tài liệu chân thực này.

metas.name: My Mom Jayne
metas.description: Through deeply personal interviews with her siblings and an examination of the photographs, letters, and belongings left behind, Mariska assembles a new portrait of her mother Jayne Mansfield, an extraordinary and complex woman.

metas.name: UFOs and Nukes - The Secret Link Revealed
metas.description: The definitive documentary on UFO activity at nuclear weapons sites, produced by renowned researcher Robert Hastings. Interviews with former U.S. Air Force nuclear missile launch officers who unequivocally state that UFOs have long monitored and even tampered with American ICBMs. Their dramatic testimony is reinforced by revealing declassified documents which convincingly confirm this situation as real and ongoing, extending from the 1940s to the present day. Sometimes fact is indeed stranger than fiction.

metas.name: X-Rated 2: The Greatest Adult Stars of All Time
metas.description: Documentary sequel that offers a close-up look into the personal lives of the legendary porn stars who've survived the test of time and influenced popular culture. Blends rare interviews with erotic clips and additional appearances by Whoopi Goldberg, Steven Soderbergh and a host of adult stars, directors and trendsetters.

metas.name: Frankenstein: Bài học giải phẫu
metas.description: Khám phá tường tận hậu trường cùng nhà làm phim có tầm nhìn xa Guillermo del Toro, dàn diễn viên và đoàn làm phim "Frankenstein" khi họ thổi luồng gió mới cho câu chuyện kinh điển.

metas.name: I, Dolours
metas.description: Dolours Price, the infamous IRA radical convicted of bombing England's Old Bailey in 1973, granted a series of revealing interviews in 2010 on the strict condition of their posthumous release. The interviews, brought to life through vividly cinematic reenactments, uncover the birth of her fierce commitment to Irish Republicanism. Price revisits the bombing and the 200-day hunger strike that followed, and discusses her role in the disappearances of some suspected Republican informants. With 2018 marking the 20th anniversary since the signing of the Good Friday Agreement, and 50 years since the start of the Troubles, filmmaker Maurice Sweeney presents an eye-opening portrait of a once passionate, now disillusioned nationalist whose clarity of purpose both inspired allegiance and promised terror for so many.

metas.name: Odyssey
metas.description: What if the United States hadn't pulled the plug on Apollo, as Apple's FOR ALL MANKIND imagined? Built from 2,500 hours of restored archival footage, director Avi Belkin masterfully constructs a riveting thriller around the fateful Apollo 13 mission. Unfolding through the intimate perspective of astronaut Jim Lovell and his family, ODYSSEY tracks his lunar dreams to that distressing message: "Houston, we've had a problem."

metas.name: Curtis
metas.description: "CURTIS (2004, Sundance, documentary, 35 min) is a loving portrait of Curtis Wheeler (1950-2003), a dancer and artist fighting to keep his independence and dignity as the end of hi struggle with HIV-AIDS takes him in and out of hospice case." (First Encounter Productions)

metas.name: Meal Ticket
metas.description: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.

metas.name: Night of the Living Steelers
metas.description: The 1970s Pittsburgh Steelers, as re-told by horror filmmaker and former Pittsburgh resident George A. Romero.

metas.name: Penthouse North
metas.description: Agneta Eckemyr has one goal in life -to hold on to her home - Penthouse North.

metas.name: Breaking Walls
metas.description: Journalist and activist Hoi Yi fights against the global rise of surveillance and censorship, while suppressing his queer identity from his family. The personal repression he faces is reflected in his commitment to the freedom of others.

metas.name: First Love
metas.description: Documentary about the first steps taken by 3 young women to become professional surfers.

metas.name: The Ascent
metas.description: The inspiring true story of bilateral-amputee climber Mandy Horvath's record-breaking attempt to crawl to the summit of Mt. Kilimanjaro and the mysterious circumstances under which she lost her legs at the age of 21.

metas.name: Nightmare Factory
metas.description: The story of how one Pittsburgh boy’s fascination with monsters drove him to the very top of the Hollywood food chain. In 1989, Greg Nicotero, much to his parents’ chagrin, quit medical school and headed for Hollywood to pursue a dream of making monsters. Together with gore masters Howard Berger and Robert Kurtzman, Nicotero went on to create KNB EFX Group, one of the most prolific makeup effects studios in the world. After twenty years as the “go to guy” for the world’s most successful horror/sci-fi films, Greg Nicotero is the first one directors like Quentin Tarantino and Robert Rodriguez call.

metas.name: Heimat
metas.description: Born in the Sudetenland, a Czech-German border region, Adolf Hampel reflects on his story of flight, deportation and refuge at the end of the second world war. Now 86 years old, Adolf embarks on a sentimental journey to thank the family of the man who protected him and his family in a time of oppression.

metas.name: Citizen King
metas.description: Documentary about the final five, turbulent years in the life of civil rights activist Martin Luther King. The story begins at the Lincoln Memorial in August 1963, when a 34-year-old preacher galvanized millions with his dream for an America free of racism and comes to a bloody end five years later on a motel balcony in Memphis.  King has since become a mythic figure, an activist whose works and image are more hotly contested, negotiated and sold than almost anyone else's in American history. (Storyville)

metas.name: Sự trỗi dậy của Red Hot Chili Peppers: Người anh em, Hillel
metas.description: Bộ phim tài liệu chân thực này dõi theo những năm tháng hình thành của Red Hot Chili Peppers và ảnh hưởng sâu sắc của thành viên sáng lập Hillel Slovak.

metas.name: Designing 'Blade'
metas.description: The makeup, stunts, special effects, and production design of 'Blade' (1998) are discussed.

metas.name: The Lion King at the Hollywood Bowl
metas.description: In honor of “The Lion King's” 30th Anniversary, the Hollywood Bowl transforms into the Pride Lands for an immersive concert event. This music event celebrates the franchise's evolution, from the 1994 animated film to the Tony Award-winning musical, and the 2019 and 2024 live-action films, honoring the music and characters that made it a global phenomenon.

metas.name: TV Party
metas.description: From 1978 to 1982, Glenn O'Brien hosted a New York city public access cable TV show called TV Party. Co-hosted by Chris Stein, from Blondie, and directed by filmmaker Amos Poe, the hour long show took television where it had never gone before: to the edge of civility and "sub-realism" as Glenn would put it. Walter Steding and his TV Party "Orchestra" provided a musical accompaniment to the madness at hand, and many artists and musicians, from The Clash, Nile Rodgers, Jean-Michel Basquiat, David Bryne and Arto Lindsey were regular guests. It was the cocktail party that could be a political party.  With 80 hours of disintegrating 3/4 inch videotape as a starting point, we tracked down the trend setting participants still living today and found out what they remember of the period and how the show influenced their lives. This, combined with clips from the orginal show, became the documentary "TV Party.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: With a magical new invention that promised to revolutionize blood testing, Elizabeth Holmes became the world’s youngest self-made billionaire, heralded as the next Steve Jobs. Then, overnight, her 10-billion-dollar company dissolved. The rise and fall of Theranos is a window into the psychology of fraud.

metas.name: Jennifer
metas.description: A short film about the actress Jennifer Salt, directed by Brian De Palma and written by Bruce Joel Rubin.  Note: As of now, the film is considered lost and no known copies are publicly available.

metas.name: Cách Cướp Ngân Hàng
metas.description: Trong bộ phim tài liệu về tội phạm có thật này, một kẻ nổi loạn cuốn hút vào những năm 1990 ở Seattle tiến hành chuỗi vụ cướp ngân hàng chưa từng có tiền lệ giống như trong phim.

metas.name: My Generation
metas.description: The vivid and inspiring story of British film icon Michael Caine's personal journey through 1960s swinging London.

metas.name: Sonderauftrag Führermuseum
metas.description: One and a half years before the begin of the Second World War during the annexation of Austria in March of 1938, Hitler conceived the megalomaniac idea of creating the largest European art center in his home town of Linz. At the beginning of the war on the 1st of September 1939, not only did his armies advance but also his art thieves began to fan out in their great foray of art plundering; an expedition on a previously unheard of scale began. Not only did the task forces of diverse National Socialist organizations pillage the occupied countries; Nazi bigwigs like Goering also took whatever they felt was valuable. This documentary includes the long and eventful journey of an exceptional masterpiece of European art: the Ghent Altar, created by van Eyck.

metas.name: Dale
metas.description: Archival race footage, outtakes, home videos and interviews Dale Earnhardt's friends, family, and competitors are used in this documentary on the racing legend who won seven NASCAR championships before his death in 2001 at the Daytona 500.

metas.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
metas.description: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

metas.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
metas.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

metas.name: The Cowboy Capital
metas.description: Bandera, Texas (THE COWBOY CAPITAL OF THE WORLD) is a captivating documentary that explores the vibrant history, unique culture, and enduring values of the small town of Bandera, Texas.

metas.name: Hồi Ức Beastie Boys - Beastie Boys Story
metas.description: Đây là câu chuyện nhỏ họ sắp kể... Mike Diamond và Adam Horovitz chia sẻ về ban nhạc và tình bạn 40 năm của họ trong phim tài liệu lưu diễn được đạo diễn bởi người bạn, người cộng tác và ông nội trước đây của họ, Spike Jonze.

metas.name: Bombay Beach
metas.description: Bombay Beach is one of the poorest communities in southern California located on the shores of the Salton Sea, a man-made sea stranded in the middle of the Colorado desert that was once a beautiful vacation destination for the privileged and is now a pool of dead fish. Film director Alma Har'el tells the story of three protagonists. Together these portraits form a triptych of manhood in its various ages and guises...

metas.name: Sự thật về nghề cá bền vững
metas.description: Mê đời sống đại dương, một nhà làm phim bắt đầu ghi lại tác hại mà con người gây ra cho các loài sinh vật biển – và lật mở những vấn nạn đáng báo động trên toàn cầu.

metas.name: Homosexual
metas.description: In this funny and erotic mockumentary, director Toby Ross takes an out of the box look at homosexuals - dividing them into two major groups: those who are into it for the sex and those who are looking for relationships. The live reenactments are an eyeful and it goes through all the levels and strands of gay guys. Out and proud, fringe homos, closet cases by design, country fags, and more.

metas.name: 1 Love
metas.description: From the Academy Award-winning director of When We Were Kings comes this enthralling tribute to the timeless power and magic of basketball.

metas.name: Doc
metas.description: The amazing adventures of forgotten American novelist and Paris Review founder, Harold Louis "Doc" Humes. His story is crammed full of ideas, about utopia, marijuana, literature, protest, paranoia and mental illness.

metas.name: Enigma
metas.description: Two legends contested their identities as women in the court of public opinion: April Ashley, who was immortalized as a trailblazer by embracing her transgender history; and Amanda Lear, who has consciously denied and obfuscated her history for decades. Their divergent paths reveal disparate but intertwined legacies.

metas.name: Số điện thoại lạ: Bê bối tin nhắn trung học
metas.description: Những tin nhắn thô tục và khiêu khích đổ dồn vào điện thoại của một thiếu nữ và bạn trai. Là ai gửi chúng và tại sao? Bộ phim tài liệu bất ngờ này sẽ hé lộ câu trả lời gây sốc.

metas.name: Đêm nhạc Pop lịch sử
metas.description: Vào một đêm tháng 1 năm 1985, những ngôi sao lớn nhất của làng nhạc quy tụ để thu âm "We Are the World". Bộ phim tài liệu này vén màn hậu trường của sự kiện lịch sử ấy.

metas.name: Zen World
metas.description: Journey inside one of the world's most unique gatherings. Discover how an entire community of gatherers from around the world find peace and love through live music, art and performance.

metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

metas.name: LCD Soundsystem: Shut Up and Play the Hits
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Brooklyn-based electronic rock band LCD Soundsystem's then-final live show on April 2, 2011, capturing both the exuberant, three-hour farewell concert at New York City's Madison Square Garden and frontman James Murphy's introspective 48 hours surrounding it.

metas.name: Minnesota Nice
metas.description: A collection of cast interviews and behind-the-scenes clips from the Coen brother's Academy Award-winning film "Fargo." Produced for the "Fargo" DVD.

metas.name: Condo Painting
metas.description: John McNaughton's spotlight on George Condo and his art. The film, which follows the progress of Condo's large-scale oil painting Big Red over the course of one year, features an appearance by Allen Ginsberg, as well as footage of Condo collaborating with William S. Burroughs on paintings the two made together at Burroughs' Kansas home in the mid-1990s.

metas.name: SPERMWORLD
metas.description: Three men enter the new wild west of baby making, online forums where sperm donors connect with hopeful parents, but find themselves exchanging more than just genetic material.

metas.name: Celling Out
metas.description: Documentary exploring the history and cultural impact of cellphones featuring scientists, cultural critics, and filmmakers. Produced for the "Cellular" DVD.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
metas.description: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

metas.name: Sidney
metas.description: Từ nhà sản xuất Oprah Winfrey, đây là bộ phim tài liệu tôn vinh và hé lộ nhiều điều về Sidney Poitier - diễn viên, nhà làm phim và nhà hoạt động dân quyền huyền thoại. Phim có những cuộc phỏng vấn với Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Barbra Streisand và hơn thế nữa.
